hook: Ultracold molecules host a synthetic lattice with edge states lasting about 500 tunnelling periods.
summary: Synthetic dimensions use internal states of a particle as extra lattice sites. The team used rotational states of RbCs molecules linked by microwaves to build a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice and tested edge state robustness against perturbations. The lattices span only up to eight states, so this is a small-scale demonstration.
title: Probing topological edge states in a molecular synthetic dimension
